tagline: A busy European side transit and business hub — the junction of the M2 metro and TEM highway, surrounded by offices and growing commercial activity.

items.name: Zorlu Center Cafés
items.description: The premium Zorlu Center retail and cultural complex has excellent café options in a modern architectural setting.

items.name: Zorlu Center Restaurants
items.description: A curated selection of quality restaurants in the Zorlu Center complex. Istanbul's best upscale mall dining.

items.name: Zorlu Center (PSM Performing Arts)
items.description: Istanbul's premier performing arts venue with world-class concerts, theatre, and dance. Check the programme — Istanbul's answer to Lincoln Center.

tips: Gayrettepe is on the M2 metro line — excellent connections to the city centre.
Primarily a transit and business district. Zorlu Center is the main cultural and retail draw.
Zincirlikuyu metro (nearby) also connects to the E-5 highway buses for other districts.
Better for a concert or business meeting than a leisure day — head to Nişantaşı or Bomonti for that.
